name: Pikabuu: STOP!
detailed_description:
"Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything."

Gameplay & Narrative

Step into the shoes of Beni, the head of this family, in a game that vividly portrays the realistic struggles of a household on the brink. Your journey focuses intensely on Beni's story, where every choice you make holds significant weight, profoundly influencing the narrative's direction and ultimately, its conclusion. You will be faced with various choices that can lead your family either to happiness or into the abyss of misery.

Features

  • Impactful Choices & Multiple Endings: Navigate through a series of crucial decisions that directly shape your family's fate. Discover 6 distinct endings, each a direct consequence of your actions.

  • Realistic & Emotional Immersion: Experience the raw, emotional tension within the family as events unfold around you. The game is designed to immerse you deeply in the atmosphere and psychological weight of their struggles, making the tension as real and emotional as possible. You will truly feel the family's situation.

  • Deep Narrative Focus: Immerse yourself in the gripping story of Beni and his family's fight for survival against unforeseen circumstances.

  • Psychological Horror: Delve into an intense atmosphere where the dark consequences of desperate actions are laid bare.

  • Button Mashing Challenges: Engage in thrilling, precisely-timed sequences that test your reflexes and add to the escalating tension.

  • Mature Themes: Explore sensitive and adult topics, including domestic violence (depicted with visible injuries), the devastating cycle of profound financial ruin, and their immense impact on a family.
